propositions: Pin drift, enforcement posture, and review-phase compatibility must be surfaced in detailed CLI show, MCP ticket detail, audit output, close errors, and web review UI without adding noise to ordinary ticket lists or persisting warning events.

Detailed renderers must consume the DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract and display canonical related tickets with normalized role, pinned/current fingerprint status, missing-target state, enforcement effect, and phase metadata.

When pin enforcement is disabled, pin drift must be labeled as advisory; legacy-unpinned must be distinguishable from current-no-relationships, while ordinary list output and stored ticket events remain unchanged.
Audit rendering must call compute_validity and handle missing attestation, unexpected output, timeout, or exception at the build_context/page assembly boundary without changing audit_trail behavior.

Output schemas, rendering tests, and advanced documentation must cover plan-material-pin, phase metadata, rollout behavior, deletion repair, and validity profiles without adding this content to basic user docs.
